title: Qwen3.6-27B-3bit-mlx
summary: A high-performance 3-bit MLX quantization of the Qwen3.6-27B model, specifically optimized for Apple Silicon users. It employs a mixed-precision strategy to balance speed and intelligence, making large-scale reasoning viable on 16GB RAM hardware.
research_notes: Requires enabling 'preserve_thinking' in chat templates; utilizes 5-bit precision for critical layers (embedding/prediction) to maintain semantic quality.

evolution.summary: This version follows the official Qwen3.6 launch and introduces a 'Thinking' mode for complex reasoning. It significantly optimized inference speeds on Macs, reportedly performing twice as fast as early community 3-bit ports.
